automatic_continuation_semantics: A true state value permits automatic dispatch only to the listed deterministic recovery or fresh role; it never authorizes an AUTO_CONTINUE event.
auto_continue_event_rule: AUTO_CONTINUE is permitted only after TERMINAL_PUBLISHED validates the terminal record, unit ledger transition, complete replay, absence of current-position nonterminal state, and legitimate successor due position.

states.recognition: ledger is valid and CONTINUE; current position directory and current record are absent; due queue entry is scientific
states.head_behavior: unchanged until deterministic materialization commit
states.fail_closed: queue, authorization, discovery provenance, or source identity fails validation

states.recognition: validated due queue metadata is inspection_eligible=false with exact frozen repository-anchor administrative code
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due until one administrative record is published
states.head_behavior: one descendant publication commit
states.fail_closed: unrecognized administrative code or scientific artifact exists

states.recognition: current position has the exact recoverable materialization blocker or is an otherwise empty current directory; authorization and manifest are absent
states.head_behavior: one descendant materialization recovery commit; blocker bytes unchanged
states.fail_closed: blocker identity differs or any output conflicts

states.recognition: authorization and complete sealed candidate manifest both validate; TPTM result is absent
states.ledger_relationship: materialized position remains due and ledger is unchanged
states.head_behavior: materialization commit is current or a validated descendant
states.fail_closed: authorization/manifest identity or hash binding fails

states.recognition: position is materialized and no complete TPTM envelope/result/routing triple exists
states.head_behavior: next controller must create a descendant state commit
states.fail_closed: partial TPTM triple is unexplained

states.recognition: hybrid-routing.state is AUTO_MECHANICAL_REJECT and no current terminal record exists
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due pending terminal publication
states.head_behavior: publication must be one validated descendant commit
states.fail_closed: routing triple or candidate binding fails

states.recognition: hybrid-routing.state is OUT_OF_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED and no current terminal record exists
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due pending terminal publication
states.head_behavior: publication must be one validated descendant commit
states.fail_closed: routing triple or candidate binding fails

states.recognition: hybrid-routing.state is STRUCTURED_REVIEW_REQUIRED and bounded A assignment is absent
states.head_behavior: controller creates bounded A assignment in a descendant commit
states.fail_closed: review packet is absent or invalid after review routing

states.recognition: validated bounded AI-A assignment exists and AI-A decision is absent
states.head_behavior: review process is isolated and cannot mutate production
states.fail_closed: assignment hashes, allowlist, or authority fail validation

states.recognition: same durable boundary as AI_FIRST_ASSIGNMENT_READY immediately before fresh semantic review
states.head_behavior: isolated process leaves HEAD unchanged; accepted decision gets its own commit
states.fail_closed: invalid YES/NO/UNKNOWN decision or unresolved evidence reference

states.recognition: validated authoritative AI-A decision exists; no B assignment, combined review, or terminal record exists
states.head_behavior: decision has an accepted descendant commit
states.fail_closed: decision projection or assignment binding fails

states.recognition: AI-A decision is valid and frozen Reviewer-B trigger/next action has not yet been durably completed
states.head_behavior: fresh continuation controller must create a descendant transition
states.fail_closed: frozen B requirement cannot be computed

states.recognition: frozen second-review requirement is false after validated AI-A decision
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due pending A-only continuation
states.head_behavior: continuation publishes or advances construction in a descendant commit
states.fail_closed: B artifacts exist outside trigger

states.recognition: frozen second-review requirement is true and no B assignment exists
states.head_behavior: continuation creates blinded B assignment in a descendant commit
states.fail_closed: B trigger or blinding boundary cannot be validated

states.recognition: a base B assignment exists at the correct trigger but lacks the complete deterministic hash interface and no B decision exists
forbidden_conflicts: A semantic paths in B allowlist
states.head_behavior: append-only numbered assignment correction commit
states.fail_closed: correction would require semantic choice or expose A material

states.recognition: the latest triggered blinded B assignment has the exact frozen control fields and only its mechanically copied evidence/interface identity is incomplete; no B decision exists
forbidden_conflicts: A semantic paths in B allowlist
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due and ledger is unchanged
states.head_behavior: append-only numbered B assignment completion commit
states.fail_closed: the base assignment is not exactly mechanically completable or blinding would change

states.recognition: latest blinded B assignment validates and B decision is absent
forbidden_conflicts: A semantic material in B capsule
states.head_behavior: isolated B process leaves HEAD unchanged; accepted B decision gets its own commit
states.fail_closed: blinding, assignment, or decision validation fails

states.recognition: validated authoritative blinded AI-B decision exists and combined review is absent
states.head_behavior: B decision has an accepted descendant commit
states.fail_closed: A/B packet identity differs

states.recognition: A and triggered B decisions validate and no combined-review artifact exists
states.head_behavior: fresh combination controller creates a descendant transition
states.fail_closed: combination differs from frozen exact-disagreement rule

states.recognition: authoritative A-only or combined review outcome is REVIEW_REJECT
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due pending non-FINAL publication
states.head_behavior: controller publishes one descendant terminal commit
states.fail_closed: review hash or publication binding fails

states.recognition: authoritative A-only or combined review outcome is REVIEW_RETAIN and construction is absent
states.head_behavior: controller may construct only under frozen family procedure
states.fail_closed: construction lacks unique focal hypothesis

states.recognition: authoritative A-only or combined outcome is REVIEW_UNRESOLVED
states.head_behavior: controller follows frozen disagreement policy in a descendant commit
states.fail_closed: disagreement policy is bypassed

states.recognition: combined review authorizes CONSTRAINED_FAMILY_FEASIBILITY_INVESTIGATION and feasibility artifact is absent
states.head_behavior: fresh combination controller records constrained feasibility
states.fail_closed: scope exceeds frozen focal/disagreement policy

states.recognition: family feasibility reason is NO_UNIQUE_FOCAL_HYPOTHESIS_UNDER_FROZEN_DISAGREEMENT_POLICY
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due pending failure publication
states.head_behavior: controller publishes FAMILY_CONSTRUCTION_FAILED
states.fail_closed: failure is reinterpreted as retained family

states.recognition: review retains and no family recipe/construction result exists
states.head_behavior: controller performs frozen construction in a descendant transition
states.fail_closed: p*(S), p*(C), p*(I) condition is altered

states.recognition: family_construction_state is FAILED for a validated family-feasibility artifact
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due pending failure publication
states.head_behavior: controller publishes non-FINAL failure
states.fail_closed: failed construction is admitted

states.recognition: family construction succeeds with a bound recipe and executable validation has not completed
states.head_behavior: controller advances to executable validation
states.fail_closed: family identity or recipe hash fails

states.recognition: constructed family is ready and no hash-bound family-executable-validation.json exists
states.head_behavior: controller records executable evidence in a descendant transition
states.fail_closed: executable authority is bypassed

states.recognition: validated hash-bound family-executable-validation.json has validation_state FAILED
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due pending failure publication
states.head_behavior: controller publishes non-FINAL validation failure
states.fail_closed: failed executable evidence is admitted

states.recognition: hash-bound executable evidence validates p*(S)=TRUE, p*(C)=TRUE, p*(I)=FALSE plus frozen oracle, witness, focal-change, category, and repository-independence requirements
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due pending FINAL publication
states.head_behavior: controller publishes exactly one terminal descendant commit
states.fail_closed: admission or category/repository cap validation fails

states.recognition: a validated terminal scientific outcome exists but current record and ledger transition are both absent
states.head_behavior: fresh appropriate controller publishes one descendant commit
states.fail_closed: outcome is ambiguous

states.recognition: record N validates, ledger includes N, full replay passes, and next_due_position is N+1
states.ledger_relationship: records_published and successor_positions_processed each advanced exactly one
states.head_behavior: terminal publication is a validated descendant
states.fail_closed: record, ledger, replay, or current-position absence fails

states.recognition: replayed ledger global_action is not CONTINUE
states.head_behavior: no further mutation
states.fail_closed: always stop

states.recognition: due materialization inputs identify the frozen discovery transaction but its independently verified local copy is absent
states.ledger_relationship: position remains due and ledger unchanged
states.head_behavior: copy-only provisioning does not alter scientific history
states.fail_closed: tree hashes or hardlink independence fail

states.recognition: a known append-only incomplete deterministic interface matches a registered correction trigger
states.head_behavior: only registered append-only correction output may be committed
states.fail_closed: no exact registry entry matches

states.recognition: a role process exited or disappeared and durable repository state has not yet been classified
states.ledger_relationship: must be replayed from disk before next role
states.head_behavior: actual HEAD is read and ancestry validated
states.fail_closed: durable state or ancestry is unexplained

states.recognition: external expected HEAD is stale while actual HEAD is a forward descendant containing only a coherent current-position transition whose ledger and exact durable artifacts validate
states.ledger_relationship: actual ledger is authoritative only after checksum and full replay validation
states.head_behavior: atomically reconcile external expected_head to the validated descendant without changing repository bytes
states.fail_closed: ancestry, changed-path scope, replay, or durable classification is unexplained

states.recognition: one current terminal record exists outside the old ledger or exact publication files are valid but uncommitted
states.ledger_relationship: at most one deterministic N to N+1 transition is pending
states.head_behavior: reconciler completes/commits exact publication files
states.fail_closed: record cannot produce one valid replayed ledger
